question: What is the meaning of use-phase management in relation to life cycle information?
description: Use-phase management in relation to life cycle information refers to the assessment and optimization of the expected lifespan of utilized products during their operational stage. This involves comparing the potential functional lifespan of a product (L) to the industry average lifespan of the building layer it is applied in (Lav), and calculating the weighted average of all products from the various system layers. The goal is to improve the efficiency and sustainability of the products used in buildings throughout their life cycle.
